Trama __VERSION__ is an early test release. Each installer includes the local MCP server.

The app checks for signed updates and can install them from Preferences. Restart agent sessions to connect them to the updated version of Trama.

- **macOS Apple Silicon:** DMG for Apple Silicon Macs.
- **macOS Intel:** DMG for Intel Macs.
- **Windows x64:** installer for 64-bit Windows.

These test builds are not notarized on macOS or code-signed on Windows. macOS may require approval in Privacy & Security; Windows may show a SmartScreen warning.

See the [macOS installation guide](https://github.com/builtbyajax/Trama/blob/main/docs/installation.md#macos) or [Windows installation guide](https://github.com/builtbyajax/Trama/blob/main/docs/installation.md#windows) before opening the app.
